text: Every redesigned screen uses the same card treatment: the frame is the surface, inside it is a recessed well (surface-sunken), and every pane and content card is its own card with a border and shadow. Panes are never flat areas inside one big card.
rationale: Chris 2026-10-07: practice card was all one card with shadows only around the main card; lesson and Study Topics were wrong; all redesign work should already follow his stated preferences
